# NFL Daily — 2026-11-01 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (thumb) was ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Bills on the first offensive play of his return from a three-game absence; backup Tyler Huntley (toe) also left, leaving Baltimore on third-string QB Joe Fagnano. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50349558/ravens-lamar-jackson-rest-game-thumb-injury)
- Lions LB Jack Campbell was placed on a spinal board, carted off and transported to a hospital for evaluation of a neck injury. [Rapoport](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2116998091119394886)
- Eagles RB Saquon Barkley will not be traded before the Nov. 10 deadline, sources say, ending speculation despite Philadelphia's struggles. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50336880/sources-eagles-trade-star-rb-saquon-barkley)
- Colts are not actively shopping RB Jonathan Taylor ahead of the deadline, though ownership gave him no assurance a trade won't happen. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/jonathan-taylor-trade-rumors-colts-not-shopping-around/)
- Raiders do not plan to trade DE Maxx Crosby, who wants to stay in Las Vegas, sources tell ESPN. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50335308/raiders-not-planning-trading-maxx-crosby-sources-say)
- WR Jauan Jennings turned down a trade back to the 49ers, choosing to stay with the unbeaten Vikings. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/jauan-jennings-declines-49ers-trade-stay-vikings)
- NFL will review additional allegations against Packers RB Josh Jacobs after new police records surfaced beyond his May arrest. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50338005/nfl-review-additional-allegations-packers-jacobs)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-01 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- QB Lamar Jackson (thumb) was ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Bills after getting hurt on the first offensive play of his return from a three-game absence. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50349558/ravens-lamar-jackson-rest-game-thumb-injury)
- Backup QB Tyler Huntley (toe) also left the Bills game, forcing Baltimore to turn to emergency third quarterback Joe Fagnano. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/who-is-ravens-joe-fagnano-baltimore-quarterbacks-lamar-jackson/)
- CB Nate Wiggins (stinger) was pulled from the Bills game and is being evaluated for a possible concussion. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2116996423795486877)
